sloka: ततः संवदतोरेवं सूतलक्ष्मणयोः पथि ।अस्तमर्के गते वासं केशिन्यां तावथोषतुः ।। ७.५१.३२ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ saṁvadatorevaṁ sūtalakṣmaṇayoḥ pathi ।astamarke gate vāsaṁ keśinyāṁ tāvathoṣatuḥ ।। 7.51.32 ।।

translations.english: Thus ends the fifty-first canto of the Uttara Kanda in the Ramayana, the first poem, composed by the sage Valmiki.
